messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":9,"verses":[{"chapter":9,"verse":11,"text":"But I said to them: \"Raise me that I may stand up, and they lifted me, holding up my arms from both sides."},{"chapter":9,"verse":12,"text":"And I stood upright, and pronounced first the praise of God and after the prayer I said to them : Look with your eyes to the East."},{"chapter":9,"verse":13,"text":"And they looked and saw my children with crowns near the glory of the King, the Ruler of heaven."},{"chapter":9,"verse":14,"text":"And when my wife Sitis saw this, she fell to the ground and prostrated [herself] before God, saying: Now I know that my memory remains with the Lord\"."},{"chapter":9,"verse":15,"text":"And after she had spoken this, and the evening came, she went to the city, back to the master whom she served as slave, and lay herself down at the manger of the cattle and died there from exhaustion."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 11,12,13,14,15 in this chapter.
